title: BMI Calculator
description:
```
Weight (kg): 70
Height (cm): 175
BMI: 22.9
Healthy range for your height: 56.7 kg - 76.3 kg
Category: Normal
```
requirements: Height input in cm, converted to metres (`static_cast` / doubles)
Use nested `?:` to choose the category string (`bmi < 18.5 ? "Under" : bmi < 25 ? "Normal" : ...`)
